remarks:
This beautiful 29 acre property includes open land and frontage on Black Creek located in New Hudson NY, Allegany County.

This open and versatile parcel offers an excellent opportunity for a future homesite, recreational property, or agricultural use. Once used as farmland, the property features open acreage with tillable soil and plenty of room to create your own vision. Black Creek runs along the property offering hundreds of feet of creek frontage and a peaceful setting for enjoying the outdoors. The creek is stocked annually with trout making this an especially appealing property for fishing enthusiasts.

With electric available in the vicinity and the potential for a buildable homesite, this property offers both recreational enjoyment and future possibilities. Whether you're looking to build a home, establish a small farm, enjoy fishing and outdoor recreation, or simply invest in land, this 29-acre parcel is worth a look. Come explore the possibilities and make this beautiful piece of land your own!
